Something is not right in Marapur and everything points to the moon. At {npc:Saraki}'s request you gather clues across the Naga islands, discover the crater of a fallen piece of the moon, investigate the Asuri, defeat the werepanther {creature:Rakesh Moonfang} in Oskayaat and sabotage the machines of the Asura Citadel until you face {creature:The Moonsnow Magnolia}. The reward is a {item:Skewered Fish} to tame the {item:Jaracal (Mount)|Jaracal} as a mount.
Lately something seems to be wrong in Marapur. Rumours say it has to do with the moon. Maybe you should talk to Saraki about it.
No minimum level set, but the **recommended level is 400+** (two bosses: Rakesh Moonfang and The Moonsnow Magnolia).
The **Lost Paradise** part of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest} completed.
required to collect the blue lava (mission 4)
A tool to collect the plant samples (mission 1)
to tame a Jaracal and get the Jaracal mount
**Six Steps Ahead** achievement (when you tame the Jaracal)
*Search for the Crater* mission: {npc:Sharai} gives you access to the hidden cave ({key:hi}, {key:moon}); then use the stones to the south-east to enter.
At the end of the quest, {npc:Saraki} gives you a {item:Skewered Fish}: use it on a {creature:Jaracal} to tame it.
On taming it you earn the achievement **Six Steps Ahead**.
With almost all the quest NPCs the keyword is {key:moon}.
Always carry the {item:Moon Mirror} with you from mission 4 onwards.
Mission 4 has to be done **at night** (in-game time) for the volcano lava to work.
Saraki asks you for three clues about the strange things happening on the Naga islands.
Go to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains|Kha'zeel Mountains}, between Tiquanda and Ankrahmun, and step into the portal at the top of the mountain (floor +5). You are teleported to {wiki:Marapur|Marapur}.
To return to the mainland, go to the magic carpet in **Moonfall** and talk to {npc:Ziyad}: say {key:hi} and ask him about the destinations (magic carpets are for Premium players only).
In **Marapur**, talk to {npc:Saraki}: {key:hi}, {key:moon}. She opens the quest and says that {npc:Sundara} and {npc:Tarisu} may have clues.
If you started the quest by talking to {npc:Nilavarna} instead of Saraki, ask {npc:Nipuna} for this clue instead of Sundara.
Talk to {npc:Tarisu}: {key:hi}, {key:Tides}. He gives you a {item:Shell Gauge} and asks you to mark 3 locations.
Use the {item:Shell Gauge} on the **Tide Markers**: 1 at the **Sparkling Lagoon** and 2 in the **Emerald Gardens**.
Talk to {npc:Dhira}: {key:hi}, {key:plants}. He asks you to inspect a {item:Sample of Bluish Tide Veil} and a {item:Sample of Bluish Whisper Reed}.
Go to the **Sparkling Lagoon** and use a tool on the two plants to collect the samples.
Take the samples to the laboratory and use them on the **refiner of magic**.
With the three clues, go back to {npc:Saraki}: {key:hi}, {key:moon}.
Go to the **observation tower** and talk to {npc:Udu}: {key:hi}, {key:moon}. He asks you to find the piece of moon that fell off the **east** coast of the Emerald Gardens.
Head **northeast** of the Emerald Gardens until you find {npc:Sharai}: {key:hi}, {key:moon}. She gives you access to the hidden cave to the **southeast**.

Use the **stones** at this spot to be transported to the hunting area. Take a few steps: the Quest Log updates and asks you to explore the area and investigate the Asuri. The wiki does not describe another exit from this area: to return to Marapur, go back to the spot where the stones left you.
Access stones to the hidden cave
Head **north** until you find 2 doors. The "stone door" on the **right** is locked; use the **red door on the left**, which is open.
Continue **north** and talk to {npc:Javala}: {key:hi}, {key:moon}. She gives you the key to the stone door.

Go down one floor and head **southwest** to a room that looks like a laboratory. Inspect everything in the room, **especially the note on the wall and the Crystal Plinth**, until the Quest Log updates.
Enter the room to the **north**: it has a piece of moonshard in the middle. Explore the room and use one of the **Large Crystal Apparatus** containers for another Quest Log update.
Go back to {npc:Javala} to receive the next mission.

Go to {wiki:Oskayaat}: leave Marapur by {npc:Ziyad}'s magic carpet to **Ankrahmun** (or another destination from which you can get there) and ask the boatman {npc:Tonar} for {key:passage}; you disembark from his boat in Oskayaat (you need the Paradise Lost part of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest}). {npc:Niral} is underground: enter the Weretiger cave, go through the {item:Fog Portal} and head **northeast** to his room (the same way as in the Grimvale Quest). Talk to {npc:Niral}: {key:hi}, {key:moon}. He asks for help to eliminate a moon-infused werewolf, {creature:Rakesh Moonfang}.

Go back to the upper floor, head **southeast** and step into the portal. Defeat {creature:Rakesh Moonfang}. The wiki does not describe the exit from the boss room: go back through the portal/the way you came in to {npc:Niral}.
It is a boss: go prepared (level 400+ recommended) and preferably in a team.
Go back to {npc:Niral}. He explains how to create **Blue Lava**.
Go up to the surface and head **southwest** of Oskayaat, to the shipwreck. Search the pile of flasks for an {item:Empty Crystal Flask}.

Take the flask to the **active volcano** on the **east** side of Oskayaat, **at night**. With the {item:Moon Mirror} on you, use the {item:Empty Crystal Flask} on the lava: you get a {item:Crystal Flask with Blue Lava}.
It does not work without the Moon Mirror in your inventory or outside the night period.
Go back to {npc:Niral}: {key:hi}, {key:moon}. He blesses the lava and you get a {item:Crystal Flask with Blessed Blue Lava}.

Return to Marapur (from Oskayaat, {npc:Tonar} takes you to Ankrahmun; from there go up to the portal in the Kha'zeel Mountains) and enter the {wiki:Asura Citadel} again through the stones next to {npc:Sharai}. Go down to the **lowest floor** and head **west**, through the door, to the room with the moon shard. There are 4 **Large Crystal Apparatus**: use the {item:Crystal Flask with Blessed Blue Lava} on the tile **south** of each one to reveal a fallen star glyph. After the 4 glyphs, you gain access to the boss.
The boss {creature:The Moonsnow Magnolia} is to the **southeast**, on floor **-2**. During the fight **portals** appear around the room: step on them to stop more monsters from entering the fight.
When the boss reaches red health, it **pretends to die and returns to full health**. Keep fighting until it dies for good.
With the boss dead, go **south** through the teleport to a new area: you get stuck in a prison. Use the **skeleton to the east** to get a torch and use the torch on the **north** wall.

Use the **icicle to the southwest** to get an {item:Icicle Chisel}. Use the chisel on the wall and you are free from the icy tomb. The wiki does not describe the way back from here: leave the Asura Citadel the way you came in and return to Marapur.
Go back to {npc:Saraki}, in Marapur: {key:hi}, {key:moon}. The quest is completed and you receive a {item:Skewered Fish}.
Use the {item:Skewered Fish} on a {creature:Jaracal} to tame it and get the {item:Jaracal (Mount)|Jaracal} mount. You earn the **Six Steps Ahead** achievement.
